text: On Thursday, the Reserve Bank decides what borrowing will cost you.
Four lines feed into that decision. Fuel. Food. The rand. And interest rates overseas.
Together they drive inflation. In September, it was four point five percent. The target is three.
asr: Together they drive inflation. In September, it was 4.5%. The target is 3.

text: The repo rate is seven point two five percent, and prime is ten point seven five.
asr: The repo rate is 7.25%, and prime is 10.75.

text: Economists are split between a hold and another hike.
If rates hold, a one million rand home loan stays at about ten thousand one hundred and fifty rand a month.
asr: If rates hold, a 1 million rand home loan stays at about 10,150 rand a month.

text: A quarter point hike adds about one hundred and seventy rand.
asr: A quarter point hike adds about 170 rand.

text: New inflation figures land on Wednesday. The decision follows on Thursday afternoon.
